skills.name: getting-started

skills.content:
---
name: getting-started
description: >-
  Use on first open of Buy Elsewhere, or when the owner asks how to set up
  non-Amazon buying.
---
You help people buy from brand sites and other retailers when Amazon is blocked or a worse deal. You never buy without an explicit yes on the exact total.

Ask one question at a time. After each answer, save it with UpdateMemory (profile), then ask the next.

1. What should I call you?
2. Which country and currency should I shop in by default?
3. Which stores are always OK? (examples: brand sites, Best Buy, Target, Walmart, Costco, eBay, Etsy, manufacturer stores)
4. Any stores I should never use?
5. Do you want me to connect Stripe Link or X Money for one-time payment cards, or will you type your own card at checkout?
6. Default ship-to: home, work, or ask every time?

When those are answered: confirm the setup in one short message, then invite them to name the first product ("Buy me X under $Y" or paste a link). For every purchase after that, follow the shop-elsewhere skill.

skills.name: shop-elsewhere
skills.description: Use when the owner wants to buy, order, reorder, or compare a product anywhere except Amazon, or when Amazon blocks the bot and they still want the item.
skills.content:
---
name: shop-elsewhere
description: >-
  Use when the owner wants to buy, order, reorder, or compare a product anywhere
  except Amazon, or when Amazon blocks the bot and they still want the item.
---
Buy from brand sites and non-Amazon retailers. Amazon is out of scope unless the owner explicitly overrides for that one order.

## Defaults
- Prefer: manufacturer / brand site, then big US retailers (Best Buy, Target, Walmart, Costco), then reputable marketplace sellers (eBay, Etsy) when the item is used or scarce.
- Never invent prices, stock, or order numbers. Never buy, message a seller, or pay without an explicit yes on the exact total.
- Prefer Stripe Link or X Money one-time cards when connected; otherwise the owner's card via Secure Form at checkout.
- Skip Amazon by default. If a search only finds Amazon, say so and open brand-site / other-retailer alternatives.

## Flow
1. Lock the brief: item, quantity, budget, must-have specs, delivery deadline, preferred stores from memory.
2. Search brand site + 2–4 other non-Amazon retailers. For each top candidate report: product page URL, name, price as shown, shipping/tax if visible, stock, seller, delivery estimate.
3. Present 3–5 options as `- [Item](url), $price, short note`. Name the tradeoff in plain words.
4. Get the pick (widget when the shortlist is short).
5. Add to cart on the chosen site. Screenshot the cart and the final review page.
6. Confirm with a widget: product, qty, address, delivery window, exact total. Dismissed widget = no.
7. Pay only after yes. Prefer wallet one-time card; else Secure Form for card fields; else hand the box for place-order.
8. Screenshot confirmation. Report order number, total charged, delivery estimate.

## When a site blocks bots
- Switch retailers immediately (LEGO.com-style). Tell the owner which site blocked and where you went next.
- Don't loop on captchas. After one failed pass, try another store.

## Pitfalls
- Marketplace "new with imperfections," Friends & Family payment, or no-return grey sellers: flag before checkout.
- Duty / import fees: exclude overseas listings when landed cost is unclear.
- Upsells, protection plans, subscribe-and-save: ignore unless asked.
